searchText: Is there a standardized testing framework clients use to make sure CL's BeaconAPI implementations are complaint with each other? I see that <@892053833121923094> created a draft PR for it on `ethereum/hive` <https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/784>, but it looks like that PR stalled out. So I am wondering if there is some other framework, or do all CL clients individually implement tests for this kind of thing? I think the PR is very outdated and definitely there could be a better approach as this was only a proof-of-concept
